# BEV address register, a sample

Twenty addresses cut from the BEV Adressregister's relational tables
("Adresse Relationale Tabellen – Stichtagsdaten", reference date 2025-10-01),
unchanged except that only the rows the specs need are kept. The specs of
`bff/site-resolution/` read them: Graz, Leoben, Knittelfeld (one `Hauptplatz 1`
in three Gemeinden), Vienna's first district, and Mittelberg in the
Kleinwalsertal (design E30).
